answer: Mirror commit-reveal bond: each identity locks 70 credits and posts a hollow commitment, the hash of a secret pearl token, to the public mirror. It must reveal the pearl within 3 epochs; the mirror checks hash, freshness. Missed or reused reveals burn it. First 38, k-th 38+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,035,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented reveals fail: a borrowed pearl lacks the renter's signature. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps its bond.
